dates.name: Utah Jazz vs. Denver Nuggets
dates.desc: Catch the Jazz in one of their final home games of the season. In a rebuilding year, tickets are more affordable than usual and it's still a great downtown experience — pregame drinks on 300 South, then walk over to the Delta Center.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Sound Bites & Sunset Market at Millcreek
dates.desc: A free outdoor Friday evening at Millcreek Common with live music, local artisan vendors, food trucks, and a beer bar — typically 350–500 people and a great local vibe. Grab dinner from the trucks and linger into the evening.
dates.where: Millcreek Common — 1354 E Chambers Ave, Millcreek, UT 84106

dates.name: Kevin Nealon at Wiseguys Comedy Club
dates.desc: Catch former SNL star Kevin Nealon at SLC's top comedy club. Early and late shows available — grab dinner beforehand and make a full evening of it.
dates.where: Wiseguys Comedy Club — 194 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees Baseball Game
dates.desc: Catch the Bees (Triple-A Angels affiliate) vs. the Sacramento River Cats. Casual, outdoor, affordable, and great fun with classic ballpark food.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — Downtown Daybreak, South Jordan, UT 84095

dates.name: Tulip Festival at Thanksgiving Point
dates.desc: Over 1 million tulips, daffodils, hyacinths, and poppies bloom across 55 acres at Ashton Gardens. Opening weekend adds live music, food trucks, and vendors — perfect for a slow stroll and a picnic atmosphere.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens, Thanksgiving Point — 3900 N Garden Dr, Lehi, UT 84043

dates.name: The Phantom of the Opera — Broadway at the Eccles
dates.desc: Cameron Mackintosh's acclaimed new production of the iconic Broadway musical. One of the most spectacular shows in musical theater with a full orchestra and stunning staging — limited run April 8–12, book ASAP.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park City Mountain — Pond Skim Closing Day
dates.desc: Ski season's grand finale at Park City Mountain — spring corn snow in the morning, then the legendary Pond Skim at 11 AM where skiers hit a ramp and try to skim across a pond of ice water. Costumes encouraged, crashes frequent, crowds festive.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort — 1345 Lowell Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Journey — Final Frontier Tour at Delta Center
dates.desc: Catch one of rock's greatest bands on what's billed as one of their last major North American tours. Two-plus hours of Don't Stop Believin', Open Arms, Faithfully, and more. A bucket-list concert.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Antelope Island Day Trip
dates.desc: Drive out to Antelope Island State Park for sweeping Great Salt Lake views, free-roaming bison herds, and early spring wildflowers. Hike Frary Peak for panoramic vistas or take the shorter Buffalo Point trail.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Romantic Dinner at Log Haven
dates.desc: Salt Lake's most romantic restaurant, tucked inside Millcreek Canyon with candlelit tables and a babbling waterfall just outside the window. Seasonal American menu with creative cocktails.
dates.where: Log Haven — 6451 E Millcreek Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84109

dates.name: Dinner at Riverhorse on Main — Park City
dates.desc: Park City's most celebrated restaurant, inside a stunning historic building on Historic Main Street. Elevated American menu — try the elk chop or lobster bisque. Pair with a stroll up the pedestrian-friendly Main Street.
dates.where: Riverhorse on Main — 540 Main St, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Candlelight Concert Series
dates.desc: An intimate string quartet performs in a stunning candlelit venue — tributes to Hans Zimmer, The Beatles, Queen, or ABBA depending on the night. Multiple nights available throughout April.
dates.where: Various venues, Salt Lake City — check fever.com for location

dates.name: Hand-Dipped Chocolates at Just Add Chocolate
dates.desc: Make your own hand-dipped chocolates together at this charming Lehi shop — pick your fillings and dip in your choice of coatings. It's part activity, part sugar rush, and you leave with a box of treats you made together.
dates.where: Just Add Chocolate — Lehi, UT (check justaddchocolate.com for address + hours)

dates.name: Wine & Small Plates at BTG Wine Bar
dates.desc: Salt Lake's most intimate wine bar — candlelit, low-key, and relaxed. Choose from a large rotating by-the-glass list and share artisan cheese boards and small plates.
dates.where: BTG Wine Bar — 63 W 100 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
